What's your return and refund policy?

Sent · Just now

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI

Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:

Our policy is to gladly accept returns for any Dermalogica.com purchase for any reason.

Timing: Initiate your return within 30 days of your order date to be eligible for a refund.
Eligibility: Only new or gently used items in original packaging are accepted. Items damaged or heavily used, nearly empty, or tampered/filled with other substances will not be refunded.
How to return:
Go to our online returns center and enter your order number (starting with S) and shipping ZIP code.
Select the product(s) to return, confirm details, and print the prepaid UPS shipping label.
Repackage your items, include the packing slip, affix the label, and drop the package at a UPS store.
Once we receive your return, we’ll process your refund or replacement. Only returns traceable back to our warehouse using our prepaid label will be credited.
Refund coverage: There are no return shipping, handling, or restocking fees for eligible Dermalogica.com returns.
Non‑returnable (final sale) items:
Partial kits or gift sets
Free samples
Gift with purchase items
Rewards items These will not be refunded and we are not responsible for shipping them back.
Multiple returns: Please ship each return order separately with its own corresponding label; returns without the correct prepaid label may not be refunded.
If you don’t want your order anymore: If your order has already been processed and cannot be canceled, you can still use the online return center to send it back for a refund after you receive it.
Rewards points impact: If you return a product or an order is canceled, the points earned from that purchase will be reversed or decreased, and your loyalty tier may be adjusted if it was based on that order.
